issues: Text products (Knowledge Cards, Activity Pack, Parent/Teacher Guide) render JSON.stringify output with regex-stripped braces/quotes; the result is readable but visually ragged (dangling commas/dashes at end of lines, mixed indentation, occasional orphan '-' bullets). Consider a small formatter (per-format renderer) so kit content displays cleanly to a Founder reviewing the manufactured pack.

critical_code_review_comments: LittleLegacyStudio.js is now 774 lines with 5+ in-file components (MasteringTab, PilotTab, PublishingPackage, KitTab, FeedbackTab). It has crossed the 700-line guideline — recommend extracting each tab into /app/frontend/src/pages/little-legacy/*.jsx modules for maintainability.

KitTab renders text product data via JSON.stringify(...).replace(/[{}\[\]"]/g,'').trim() — this is a display hack, not a formatter. Fine for a Founder-only preview but should be replaced by structured renderers before any customer-facing surface.
KitTab useEffect on `episodes` list uses eslint-disable for missing loadOne dep — safe but flagging for consistency.

KitTab poll interval (6s) keeps running while the Kits tab is unmounted only if timers are stored per-id; useEffect cleanup only clears timers on tab unmount (Radix TabsContent), which is fine but inconsistent with Pilot/Mastering (5s/6s polls also running in background) — consider a shared 'is-active-tab' gate.

FeedbackTab has no client-side validation on rating range (relies on min/max attributes) — a user could paste '99' and submit; backend appears to normalize (returned ok toast) but explicit clamp in submit() would be safer.
Improvement signals chip key is `s.signal` — if the backend ever emits duplicate signals the React key will collide; keying by index would be defensive.
kit img alt is `p.format` (e.g., 'Coloring Page') which is fine, but adding episode title into alt would help a11y.
